handoff: Verdict is fail with two blocking findings. The question for the user: a v2 Muse delivery names the -v2 files, but the Workbooks stage-1 check matches manifest entries to the list file name, which ends in -v1. Who changes the contract? Options: A) the Workbooks reader matches the entry by row id or by the name without the version, which needs a Workbooks commit and a PM hand-off; B) the PM orders a new picture-list version where the 4 rows name -v2, with a new list SHA pin, which changes a Workbooks file that the Forge contract keeps read only; C) Forge delivers the -v2 bytes under the list -v1 names, which keeps the reader and the list unchanged but needs PM approval, because Decision 2 and the -v2 order name the files differently; D) Forge writes a -v1 alias beside each -v2 file, which adds a file that the current contract refuses. A second question follows: the stage-1 command checks all 30 week-1 rows and takes no row filter, so a 4-job batch fails the other 26 rows. The user decides the row scope of the Workbooks run.
